Scope and player interaction

Prove the integrated player journey in a real packaged client/server environment, while distinguishing documentation static checks from gameplay verification. Release only the measured, tested scope.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase23committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

NotRun → EnvironmentReady → Executing → Failed → PassedWithEvidence → ReleaseBlocked

WBP_Diagnostics observes results from URPGAcceptanceHarness. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_TestPlan_Release. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
TestCaseId/BuildId/CatalogHash: reproducible identity
ClientCount/ServerCount/Hardware/Region: environment record
ExpectedOutcome/ObservedOutcome: separate fields
EvidencePaths: logs, captures and database assertions from actual execution
AccessibilityMatrix: keyboard/controller/text-scale/color/motion cases
ReleaseBlockers: unresolved defects with owner and severity

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGAcceptanceHarnessImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_DiagnosticsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RunAcceptanceCase(TestCaseId, FixtureProfile) -> TestRecord; future implementation test contract
AssertLedgerInvariant(CharacterId, ExpectedRevision) -> Pass|Violation; backend test adapter
RecordManualObservation(TestCaseId, Evidence) -> ReviewedRecord
EvaluateReleaseGate(ReportSet) -> Blocked|ScopeApproved

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Build development and shipping client/server targets using the installed engine packaging route and actual supported platform toolchain.
  2. Deploy an isolated backend/database and two zone processes from the same release manifest; provision two or more real test accounts.
  3. Execute Slice A, then Slice B, then the online-ready route with party/dungeon/social flows and documented fault injection.
  4. For every economic action, compare UI, authoritative state, database rows and command receipt after retry/disconnect/zone change.
  5. Run navigation/accessibility/localization/layout tests with long text, keyboard-only and controller focus; verify opening menus does not pause the server.
  6. Attach actual observed results, block release on invariant or security failures, and report the largest tested population rather than a theoretical MMO capacity.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. In Project Settings confirm maps to cook include frontend, the two initial zones and dungeon/test maps only as appropriate to the build. Development-only fixtures and secrets must be excluded from public shipping packages.
  2. Create a release fixture with two accounts, four classes, initial quest chain, merchant, ore/tree sites, fishing pool, craft station and two reciprocal gates.
  3. Use separate client processes/machines and a dedicated process without a local player; multi-PIE is a convenience regression test, not the final remote proof.
  4. Capture server-authoritative coordinates, XP, inventory/currency/quest/profession revisions, ticket epochs and receipt IDs at each route checkpoint.
  5. Force crash before and after transaction commit, destination reservation, ticket redemption and arrival acknowledgment; expected state is in the failure matrix.
  6. Validate controller remapping, readable telegraphs at text scale 150–200%, no color-only rarity meaning, subtitles/visual fishing cues and localized overflow.

Reopen Phase23 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / L_Thornweald / L_SluiceVault / separate packaged clients. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Any duplicate grant or dual active session -> ReleaseBlocked, regardless of visual polish.
Client packages but dedicated server fails -> not a multiplayer build pass.
Static docs validator passes -> does not mark Unreal/runtime test Passed.
Two-zone route sends both players away -> fail: individual ClientTravel contract violated.
Missing paid art source/license -> presentation/art gate remains blocked, even if debug placeholders are playable.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Initial acceptance uses two clients; later runs record 4/8/16/32 only when actually executed. Performance and accessibility thresholds are project acceptance proposals until tested on target hardware.

Store raw evidence privately with redacted publishable summaries. Every result records actual command, date, environment, expected/observed and reviewer; this documentation generation run has no such engine results.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
